text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm walking down the<n>hallway...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ines! I knew I could count on you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your Bakushin slides across the floor<n>applied the
wax so evenly... It was<n>like watching art in motion!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're exaggerating for<n>sure! I'm just
used to this kind of<n>work from my cleaning job.
That's<n>all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! However, as class<n>representative, etiquette
dictates that I<n>must return the favor! Please allow
me to show my gratitude somehow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Heh. Well, if you insist, then... I<n>want you to
come with me to a<n>supermarket sale!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But of course! I will gladly accompany<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Later on, during a stroll through the<n>school
grounds...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The probability of Ines being a cyborg<n>has
increased to forty-five percent.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! All I did was slice up a carrot.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. However, the thickness<n>and diameter
of the carrot slices are<n>numerically identical.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so that's what you meant.<n>Well, I guess all
those food prep jobs<n>must have honed my skills! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So your precision is the result of<n>consistent practice.
Understood.<n>Cyborg probability has fallen to zero
percent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Now I can eat a nutritious<n>meal that
reflects the data perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No prob! Call me anytime you need a<n>hand! Using a
food processor can be,<n>um, kinda tricky!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You suuure know how to do a<n>thorough cleat check,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My cleats are pretty unique, you<n>know. Even the
professionals have a<n>hard time with them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
They're definitely an interesting pair...<n>but don't
you worry! I've dealt with a<n>huge range of
customers at one of<n>my regular gigs!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it sounds like all the staff at<n>your store must
be experts. Maybe<n>I'll drop by sometime!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ding, dong... ♪ This just in—I've got a<n>juicy tip for
any prospective<n>customers!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you purchase a pair of cleats<n>today... you'll be
eligible for a fifty<n>percent discount on a second pair!
Wow! Be sure to take advantage of<n>this special
offer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, you really know how to upsell.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm just recognizing demand and<n>making sure
we supply it, that's all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During a training session some time<n>later, I'm
talking with Ines Fujin<n>about all the good deeds I
saw her<n>doing around school today.
choice_data_list: So many people rely on you.
So many people rely on you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Is that a compliment? C'mon, don't<n>stop with just
one!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Juuust kidding! Haha.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I'm doing this for my<n>own sake too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Helping others helps me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The person who gets helped is<n>happy. The person
who helps is<n>happy. Smiles all around!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's two birds with one stone! At thatpoint, why would I not want to helppeople?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know people worry about<n>me wearing
myself out, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm the type that thrives off of seeing<n>people smile!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why, if it means I can help<n>others out,
then I don't mind working<n>my butt off.
choice_data_list: That must really build up your stamina.
That must really build up your stamina.
You must learn a lot from all of your jobs.
You must learn a lot from all of your jobs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why, if it means I can help<n>others out,
then I don't mind working<n>my butt off.
choice_data_list: That must really build up your stamina.
That must really build up your stamina.
You must learn a lot from all of your jobs.
You must learn a lot from all of your jobs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! You're right on the mark!<n>I feel like I
have gotten a stamina<n>boost recently!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, maybe I'm hitting three birdswith one stone?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Talk about efficiency! I suddenly feel<n>super
motivated! There's no stopping<n>me now!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Now more motivated than ever, Ines<n>Fujin vows to
remain a do-gooder.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! So, the other day, I<n>helped the
student council with their<n>paperwork!
choice_data_list: Is there anything you won't do?!
Is there anything you won't do?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It just kind of happened, you know?<n>But anyway,
we got to talking over<n>our coffee break, and the
council<n>members had so much insight to offer<n>about
racing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Being able to casually show my face<n>here and
there is just another perk of<n>helping out! ♪
